record.title: Pakistan–Afghanistan crossing closures after October 2025 clashes
record.crossings: Torkham; Chaman; Ghulam Khan; Kharlachi; Angoor Adda
record.exceptions: Afghan departure window from November 1; later staged empty Pakistani truck repatriation reported August 2 2026. Neither establishes ordinary cargo reopening.
record.enforcement: Customs statement documents stranded vehicles; later reporting establishes ordinary trade closure through October 4, 2026 despite returnee exceptions.
record.consequences: RFE/RL interviewees describe lost crossing-related work, business relocation and family separation; these are reported experiences, not population estimates.
record.status_observation: Closure evidenced as of 2026-10-04; subsequent status unresolved
record.official_rationale: Cross-border clashes and associated security concerns.
record.context: Cross-border clashes and associated security concerns.
record.uncertainty: October 12 is broad physical closure; Chaman customs suspension separately dated October 15. Returns-only reopening is an exception, not endpoint. Ordinary trade remained closed as of October 4, 2026; no inference beyond that verified date.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
